_note: Diagnostic, not a result: no number reported in the paper rests on this file. It records an independent cross-check, by a different model family (Claude), of the labels produced by the small free-text 8B judge originally used for H3. Agreement was 16/31 on the base arm. That disagreement is what motivated retiring the 8B judge entirely on 2026-07-27 and relabelling all of H1 (95 prompts) and H3 (186 answers) with the logit_bias-forced Qwen2.5-72B judge the paper actually reports (exp/relabel_structured_2026-07-27.py, runs/relabel_2026-07-27/). The paper describes that Qwen judge only, because it is the one every reported statistic comes from. WARNING, autonomous judgment call: both the original 8B judge model and this cross-check were chosen by the AI assistant at execution time. The approved plan (Task 7) specifies judge(question, answer, model) without naming a judge model, and the author did not sign off on either choice; neither survives into the reported results. Kept in the repository rather than deleted, on the same principle as the flag in data/target_tokens_h3_taiwan.md: the labels it questions are not in the paper, but the record of how they came to be questioned belongs with the data.
